name: Capture inbox
author: wizard
description: Your agent files whatever you drop in Inbox in Files (uploads, the share menu, a synced folder), by your own plain-words rules in Files › Capture rules.md: receipts to Documents/Receipts, articles to Reading, book-page highlights into a note under the book's title, and so on. One batch at a time after a quiet couple of minutes, one line in your agent inbox, every move logged, and "undo that" puts a batch back exactly. Only what arrives after you turn it on. Read by the Agent Service (server/capture-inbox.mjs). Nothing in the shell changes.
